release_note: Not approved for manufacture. See ../PREORDER-REVIEW.md for unresolved physical-fit and electrical validation requirements.
title: HomeBrain Dedicated Sensor Motherboards v1.2 DRAFT

fabrication_defaults.assembly: Bare boards only; hand-solder the purchased modules directly to their labeled footprints

xiao_footprint.orientation: component side up; USB-C points toward +Y/top edge; factory-installed straight male header rows pass through the motherboard
xiao_footprint.mounting_method: through-hole: insert both factory-installed 1x7 straight male header rows through U1, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length

bottom_battery_pad_offsets_usb_top.derivation: Seeed PCB U2 origin (108.3977,72.876), TP10 GND (102.87,73.6346), TP9 VBAT (102.87,71.0946). KiCad Y-down, USB-right to motherboard Y-up, USB-top: x_new=dy, y_new=dx. Top-through view, NOT a mirrored underside view.

boards.name: HomeBrain Atmosphere Motherboard
boards.xiao_assembly: Insert both factory-installed 1x7 male header rows through U1, hold the XIAO component-side up with USB-C toward the USB arrow, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length.

antenna_copper_keepout.reason: No motherboard copper below or forward of the XIAO onboard ceramic antenna.

modules.name: hiBCTR BME680
modules.mechanical_status: Seller dimensioned graphic confirms overall envelope, but header-to-edge offsets are not dimensioned. Existing placement outline is not approved.
modules.mount: parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x6 male header through J1, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; sensor/board extends left

modules.name: Teyleten Robot SCD41
modules.mount: parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x4 male header through J2, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; metal sensor above header

modules.name: HiLetgo VEML7700
modules.mount: parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J3, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; light sensor above header

modules.name: PMS5003 supplied red breakout
modules.mount: parallel, component side up; insert its factory-installed 1x8 male header through J4; solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length; keyed cable socket faces right

external_connections.name: PMS5003 factory keyed cable
external_connections.rule: Use the supplied keyed eight-wire cable intact; do not cut, splice, or reorder it.

external_connections.name: USB-C power/data
external_connections.rule: The Atmosphere station requires continuous external USB power.

boards.name: HomeBrain Presence Motherboard
boards.xiao_assembly: Insert both factory-installed 1x7 male header rows through U1, hold the XIAO component-side up with USB-C toward the USB arrow, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length.

antenna_copper_keepout.reason: No motherboard copper below or forward of the XIAO onboard ceramic antenna.

modules.name: DIYables DHT11
modules.mount: vertical; insert factory-installed 1x3 male header through J1, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; blue sensor rises from the board and printed + OUT - faces inward

modules.name: HiLetgo VEML7700
modules.mount: parallel, component side up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J2, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; light sensor above header

modules.name: Hi-Link LD2410C
modules.mechanical_status: Header offsets derived from manufacturer STEP Board solid. Antenna face must point toward room; motherboard overlap is not proof of an RF keepout.
modules.mount: parallel, antenna face up; insert factory-installed 1x5 male header through J3, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; module overhangs right PCB edge; verify enclosure antenna-face clearance

external_connections.name: USB-C power/data
external_connections.rule: The Presence station requires continuous external USB power.

boards.name: HomeBrain Climate Motherboard
boards.xiao_assembly: First solder two straight rigid posts made from saved 200 kOhm resistor-lead offcuts perpendicular to the XIAO underside BAT- and BAT+ pads. Then insert both factory-installed 1x7 male header rows through U1 while guiding those posts through XB1/XB2, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect polarity and continuity, and trim all excess pin/post length.

antenna_copper_keepout.reason: No motherboard copper below or forward of the XIAO onboard ceramic antenna.

xiao_battery_fill_pads.label: BAT-
xiao_battery_fill_pads.assembly: Before installing the XIAO, solder a straight rigid post cut from a saved 200 kOhm resistor lead perpendicular to its underside BAT- pad. Guide that post through XB1 with the factory side headers, solder XB1 from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim.

xiao_battery_fill_pads.label: BAT+
xiao_battery_fill_pads.assembly: Before installing the XIAO, solder a straight rigid post cut from a saved 200 kOhm resistor lead perpendicular to its underside BAT+ pad. Guide that post through XB2 with the factory side headers, solder XB2 from the motherboard underside, verify polarity, then trim.

modules.name: DIYables DHT11
modules.mount: vertical; insert factory-installed 1x3 male header through J1, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim; blue sensor rises from the board and printed + OUT - faces inward

modules.name: MakerHawk 1.25 mm battery pigtail
modules.mount: solder the verified mating pigtail directly into BAT+ and BAT- holes; its factory connector remains detachable at the battery

external_connections.name: LiPo factory lead
external_connections.to: meter-verified mating pigtail soldered at J2
external_connections.rule: This flexible lead is unavoidable because it is integral to the pouch cell; verify polarity before first connection.

assembly_fastener.description: #4 x 3/8 in Phillips pan-head coarse-thread sheet-metal screw
assembly_fastener.recommended_purchase: Two 16-packs total; if one pack was already purchased, add one more pack.
